info.author: Claudio Lemos
info.name: llmstudio-proxy
info.summary: LLMstudio Proxy is the module of LLMstudio that allows calling any LLM as a Service Provider in proxy server. By leveraging LLMstudio Proxy, you can have a centralized point for connecting to any provider running independently from your application.
